title: Output completeness and run receipts
summary: Job receipts retain stdout, stderr, execution metadata and recorded exception observations. Dev8 drains the output backlog after process exit, including matches crossing read boundaries.
invariants: Scan no more than 64 MiB per output rule and stream; if exhausted report measurement_unavailable.
Keep child exit code separate from Computer exception status (6 for breached/incomplete observation).
A receipt lacking legacy metadata must not be called verified success.
